description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged jump attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Wind], [Awoken Dragoon], [Damage Cap +20000] and [Dragon Strike Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Dragoon
description.text: Dragoon abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Jump attacks

description.name: Dragon Strike Mode
description.text: Grants [Dragon Strike 1]/[Dragon Strike 2]/[Dragon Strike 3]/[Dragon Strike 4] after using 1/2/3/4 Dragoon abilities
